query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Create and refine a Google Slides presentation by inspecting existing slides and layouts, adding styled slides, inserting an image, and verifying the rendered result.
query_ground_truth.query: inspect existing google slides layouts and presentation structure
query_ground_truth.intent: this query searches for capabilities to read existing slide content, inspect slide dimensions, and retrieve available slide layouts from a Google Slides presentation

requirement_groups.purpose: inspect specific slide, layout, or master details

request.query: inspect existing google slides layouts and presentation structure

results.use_case: inspect existing google slides layouts and presentation structure
results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if presentation identifier unknown)] [Prerequisite]: Locate the presentation file using GOOGLEDRIVE_FIND_FILE (use returned file ID as the presentation identifier).
[Optional (if file type/access unclear)] [Prerequisite]: Verify it is a readable presentation using GOOGLEDRIVE_GET_FILE_METADATA.
[Required] [Step]: Retrieve layout inventory using GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_GET (use a minimal fields projection for layouts(objectId,layoutProperties(displayName)) to limit payload).
[Required] [Next Step]: Build a mapping of layoutProperties.displayName → objectId from the GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_GET response (treat objectId as the stable identifier).

[Optional (if you need which layouts are applied)] [Next Step]: Re-run GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_GET for slides(objectId,slideProperties(layoutObjectId)) and join slideProperties.layoutObjectId to the layout mapping.
[Optional (if you need one page’s details)] [Next Step]: Fetch that page using GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_PAGES_GET (confirm the page’s layout linkage/metadata).
[Optional (only with explicit approval if permission blocks reads)] [Fallback]: Add access using GOOGLEDRIVE_CREATE_PERMISSION, then retry GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_GET.
known_pitfalls: [GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_GET] Missing presentation identifier can fail with an error indicating the presentationId field is required.
[GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_GET] 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT can occur if the fields selector includes invalid paths (non-existent layout fields).
[GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_GET] Omitting fields may return a very large response (observed ~150k tokens); prefer a minimal projection.
[GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_GET] Some responses are nested under results[0].response.data; unwrap before iterating layouts[].
[GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_GET] layoutProperties.displayName may be duplicated or vary by whitespace/special characters; do not assume uniqueness—prefer objectId.

GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_GET.description: Tool to retrieve the latest version of a presentation. Use after obtaining the presentation ID.

fields.description: Comma-separated selector specifying which fields to include in a partial response. Nested fields use parentheses that must be properly balanced. Top-level fields: presentationId, title, locale, revisionId, pageSize, slides, masters, layouts, notesMaster. For slides/masters/layouts, valid Page fields: objectId, pageType, pageElements, pageProperties, revisionId. For pageElements, valid fields: objectId, size, transform, title, description, shape, image, video, line, table, wordArt, elementGroup, sheetsChart, speakerSpotlight. For shape, valid fields: shapeType, text, shapeProperties, placeholder. Note: 'autofit' is under shapeProperties, not directly under shape. Use shape(shapeProperties(autofit)), not shape(autofit). Examples: 'presentationId,title', 'slides(objectId,pageElements(objectId,size))', 'slides(objectId,pageElements(objectId,shape(shapeType,text,shapeProperties(autofit))))'

presentationId.description: The ID of the presentation to retrieve. Either presentation_id or presentation_name must be provided.

presentationName.description: The name of the presentation to search for and retrieve. If provided, the action will search Google Drive for a presentation with this name. Either presentation_id or presentation_name must be provided.

GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_PAGES_GET.description: Tool to get the latest version of a specific page in a presentation. Use when you need to inspect slide, layout, master, or notes page details.

pageObjectId.description: The object ID of the page to retrieve.

presentationId.description: The ID of the presentation from which to fetch the page.

GOOGLESLIDES_GET_PAGE_THUMBNAIL2.description: Tool to generate a thumbnail of the latest version of a specified page. Use when you need a preview image URL for a slide page. This request counts as an expensive read request for quota purposes.

pageObjectId.description: The object ID of the page whose thumbnail to retrieve.

presentationId.description: The ID of the presentation to retrieve.

thumbnailProperties.mimeType.description: The optional mime type of the thumbnail image. Defaults to PNG if not specified.

thumbnailProperties.thumbnailSize.description: The optional thumbnail image size. LARGE = 1600px, MEDIUM = 800px, SMALL = 200px. Defaults to LARGE if not specified.
